copy_to_model_parallel_region: copy a tensor into the model parallel region with all-reduce on the backward pass
reduce_from_model_parallel_region: all-reduce a tensor across the model parallel group in the forward pass
scatter_to_model_parallel_region: scatter a tensor across model parallel ranks by splitting along the last dimension
gather_from_model_parallel_region: gather tensors from all model parallel ranks and concatenate along the last dimension
review_mappings_module: review the Megatron model parallel mapping functions for tensor split gather and reduce operations
